single-cell.description: Single-cell RNA-seq analysis driven by scagent-sdk capabilities and floors

analyze.template: Analyze the single-cell dataset at $ARGUMENTS using the scagent tools. Begin with inspect_dataset, then follow the orchestrate-single-cell workflow (QC → clustering → batch investigation → annotation) and only call finalize_analysis once its floors pass. Rely on the durable state (facts and artifacts by execution id), not on remembered prose.

qc.template: Run cell-level QC on the current dataset: calculate_single_cell_qc, inspect every returned figure, then review_single_cell_qc. Report the QC decision.

cluster.template: Cluster the current dataset and evaluate cluster QC: run PCA/neighbors/UMAP as needed, cluster_single_cells, then evaluate_cluster_qc and review_cluster_qc.

annotate.template: Annotate cell types for the current clustering using marker evidence plus at least one reference method, then review_annotation_evidence. Do not invent labels.

state.description: Show the current durable analysis state
state.template: Summarize the current durable analysis state: the recorded facts, decisions, and the artifacts indexed by execution id. Do not re-run any tool; read from the durable checkpoint.
